text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and elevated monocyte and basophil percentages. There is mild anemia, low hematocrit, and low total CO₂, suggesting possible respiratory or metabolic acidosis. INR is elevated, indicating increased bleeding risk. Inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin) are at the upper limit. These findings may indicate acute or chronic respiratory compromise with mild bone marrow suppression and coagulopathy; clinical correlation is advised.
